second_answer_attack.resolution: The emergency-research pathway does not authorize investigators to ignore a legally authorized representative whenever one can feasibly be contacted within the therapeutic window. The defining additional prospective safeguards under 21 CFR 50.24 include IRB findings plus community consultation and public disclosure; option D instead overstates the exception.

blind_audit.rationale: This is planned FDA-regulated emergency research, not ordinary emergency treatment. The 21 CFR 50.24 pathway requires prospective IRB findings and additional protections, including consultation with representatives of the communities in which the research will occur and public disclosure before initiation, along with other specified safeguards. Strongest alternative resolved: The emergency-research pathway does not authorize investigators to ignore a legally authorized representative whenever one can feasibly be contacted within the therapeutic window. The defining additional prospective safeguards under 21 CFR 50.24 include IRB findings plus community consultation and public disclosure; option D instead overstates the exception.
